HUB.name: Tianxia
HUB.festival: **the Convergence** — the day the year's newcomers arrive through the ports; lanterns strung along every road into the capital
HUB.dish: crossroads hotpot — one pot, whatever every traveler brought. **Architecture:** concentric ring-walls and gate-arches; every building faces a road. **Proverb:** *"The center holds whoever holds the center."* **Towns:** named for roads and gates (Ninth Gate, Long Road, Two Fords). **Clans:** the Free Caravans (neutral), the Drill-Yards (combat schools). **Of note:** somewhere in the world's biggest crowd is **Waldo** — finding him is a festival game older than the walls

ENT.name: Mythoria
ENT.festival: **Maskfall** — the carnival's anniversary; five great masks paraded, none worn after sundown (the Second Age is why). **Dish:** blossom-honey skewers and festival fish. **Architecture:** boardwalks, lantern-piers, pavilion tents that never quite come down

ENT.proverb: *"Every prize on this shore was paid for twice."* **Towns:** named like attractions (Last Tide, Wheelhouse, Petal Row). **Clans:** carnival spirits (leaf/insect kin), the Quiet Troupe (never speaks, always watching). **Of note:** the sweet one, **Choco**, keeps a stall no one can find twice

BUS.name: Porthaven
BUS.festival: **First Tide** — the year's first fleet out; the Salt Gate opened with a coin thrown from every deck. **Dish:** twice-salted fish and delta oysters
BUS.architecture: warehouse-keeps on stilts, chained harbors, ledger-halls. **Proverb:** *"They salt everything twice here, and trust no one who arrives by land."* **Towns:** named for cargo (Saltquay, Copperwharf, Barrelrow). **Clans:** the Delta Toll-Gangs, the Customs Wraiths (toxin kin in the marsh)

EDU.name: Arcadia
EDU.festival: **the Examinations** — the rimwall lit with study lamps; pass, and the Academy rings its one bell for you. **Dish:** highland tea and stone-oven rice
EDU.architecture: terraced cloisters, torii-arched passes, the Grand Academy's tiered roofs
EDU.proverb: *"The mountain does not move for the ignorant."* **Towns:** named for lessons (First Question, Inkstone, Bellterrace). **Clans:** earth-kin quarry orders, telepath study-circles
EDU.townNaming: named for lessons (First Question, Inkstone, Bellterrace). **Clans:** earth-kin quarry orders, telepath study-circles

HS1.name: Aeropolis
HS1.festival: **Mooring Day** — the anniversary of the first airship mooring; every dock flies its first rope. **Dish:** cloud-orchard fruit, eaten falling-fresh
HS1.architecture: mesa terraces, mast-towers, rope-bridges with prayer flags. **Proverb:** *"Ascent is earned; the fall is free."* **Towns:** named for winds (Updraft, First Gust, Longlift). **Clans:** flyer-kin courier lodges, the Wind Shepherds

HS2.name: Emberfall
HS2.festival: **the Quenching** — one night a year the great forge is banked, and every smith drinks. **Dish:** ember-wine and ash-baked root
HS2.architecture: tiered fire-fortress, obsidian ramparts, chimney-spires. **Proverb:** *"Courage is fuel."* **Towns:** named for forgework (Firstspark, Slagline, the Bellows). **Clans:** fire-kin forge guilds, storm-callers on the caldera rim. **Of note:** **Dragon Cho** roosts the high crater — the upper of the two dragon courts

HS3.name: Empyrea
HS3.greeting: a bow; words are optional here
HS3.festival: **the Stillness** — one silent day; even the wind is said to keep it. **Dish:** frost-herb broth, served without salt (want nothing)
HS3.dish: frost-herb broth, served without salt (want nothing)
HS3.architecture: white sanctums, glass-ice colonnades, bell-towers that ring themselves
HS3.proverb: *"The light asks nothing. Match it."* **Towns:** named for virtues (Patience, Clearwater, Kept Word). **Clans:** ice-kin choristers, light-touched pilgrim orders. **Of note:** **Agena** — the star-scholar — reads tomorrow from the sanctum's highest balcony

UW1.name: Ironhold
UW1.festival: **Veinsday** — a new Midas seam struck; the whole warren gets one free swing at it. **Dish:** fungal stew in bread you could pave with. **Architecture:** pillared warrens, gate-vaults, rune-braced shafts. **Proverb:** *"The deeper the richer; the richer, the less of you comes back."* **Towns:** named for depth (Firstdelve, Ninth Landing, Lampsend)

UW2.name: Blackmere
UW2.festival: **the Unfinished Feast** — a table set at the lake edge for the Drowned Banquet's guests; no one sits, everyone leaves a dish. **Dish:** blind-fish and black-lake salt (never taken in seconds — manners matter here). **Architecture:** causeway keeps, drowned colonnades, the dead keep's silhouette on every coin. **Proverb:** *"Hunger is a door. Keep it shut."* **Towns:** named for water (Stillmere, Lastlight Landing, the Shallows). **Clans:** phantom-kin lantern-bearers, amphibious water-kin raft-folk

UW3.name: Luxuria
UW3.greeting: "What do you want?" — never answered honestly
UW3.festival: **the Bloom** — one night the Gardens flower all at once; picking one costs exactly what it's worth. **Dish:** garden fruit that tastes like whatever you miss most. **Architecture:** twilight gardens, mirror-basalt courts, the Vault itself. **Proverb:** *"Everything blooms here. Nothing bears fruit."* **Towns:** few, nameless by custom — you don't put roots in Luxuria. **Clans:** dragon-kin hoard-courts, mystic covenants

CGI.name: Olympus
CGI.greeting: "Welcome back." (everyone is presumed to have been before.)
CGI.festival: **Foundation Day** — the world's birthday, told in toasts. **Dish:** whatever the founders are having
CGI.architecture: palm-crescent villas on made land. **Proverb:** *"Someone built all this. Sit down and hear who."* **Towns:** one, itself. **Clans:** none — founders are people, not masters, and the isle is theirs. Masterless by design
